payload.title: Specify filter + laziness steps (02_filters, 03_laziness red)
payload.description:
Specs first, red before green; no production code in this task.

**Files:** `tests/steps/store_steps.rs` (red steps for the two existing feature files).

**Specs:** step definitions for the existing @wip `02_filters.feature` (source, project, part kind at session and message level, time window) and `03_laziness.feature` (take-1 opens only it; drop stops the work; message streaming never materializes the session). The "opened" / "not fully materialized" assertions go through the Query counters (the `peak_buffered` precedent). The feature files are the source of truth and stay as written; if a scenario proves unobservable, refine wording only after recording the refinement in a comment on this task.

**Acceptance:** executable red; @wip kept.

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
